Messages.Author: reyda
Messages.Body:
Hi !

i'm about to be bled to death by a giovanni power bleeder.
he has a path of bones in play.
i play Elder michaelis's hold on a copy of "Call of the hungry dead",
hoping it's enough not to be ousted this turn.
Does he have to pay one and burn one to play his call of the hungry dead
superior... Or did i make a mistake because the extra cost on CotH is
already paid by the path of bones ?

thank you.
reyda

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


The latter -- EMH increases the cost of the card to one and PoB says the
Gio burns one less blood when playing it.
